test_title: PYST 76: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can substitute/replace the bracketed word correctly and complete the sentence.

If he runs, he (get) there in time.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. will get.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option should follow the** "if"** clause in the future tense.
 
• **"Will get"** correctly follows modals with the base form of the verb to form future tense for conditional sentences.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **"Is getting"** is present continuous and does not fit in the conditional structure.
 
• **"Got there in time"** is past tense and does not work with the present/future conditional.
 
• **"Has to get"** implies obligation and changes the meaning of the sentence.
